description: Google Maps local business search via Serper: returns matching places with title, address, rating, review count, category, phone number, and website. Accepts query plus optional country code (gl) and location string for geo-targeting.

examples.location: New York, New York, United States

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Serper API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

location.description: Location string, e.g. "San Francisco, California, United States"

query.description: Search query, e.g. "coffee shops near union square"

name: places
title: Places
